tasks.short: Requisition camera repair parts and materials

steps.what: Inspect the actual camera repair need and capture equipment model, serial range, required parts or materials and quantity
Locate the actual compatible catalogue line and verify part revision, availability and current price
Assemble the actual parts requisition with selected catalogue line, quantity, repair job, price and destination
Check and correct the complete requisition against actual equipment compatibility and required delivery
Review the exact final requisition under the repair shop's actual purchasing authority
Submit the exact authorized parts requisition to the purchasing queue
Retain the ordinary requisition copy in the same repair workspace

tasks.design: Use actual equipment/catalogue links in {OTHER}, the camera repair work-order and parts-reference system, with explicit requisition fields in {PROCUREMENT}. Generate the exact-field requisition, retain compatibility checks and submit only the final version reviewed under the actual purchasing route.
tasks.previous_blocker: Parts requisitions can repeat equipment, catalogue and repair-job fields across separate work-order and purchasing screens.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit identifiers support catalogue links and deterministic field transfer.
tasks.still_hard: Similar camera assemblies can require different revisions and serial-range compatibility.
tasks.human_edge: The repairer recognizes a catalogue match that will not fit the actual equipment.

ambition.what: No autonomous parts substitution or supplier order.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: equipment/catalogue links and exact requisition mappings can reduce repeated parts-entry work while compatibility and purchasing authority remain human.

assumptions: Boundary is an actual separate purchasing requisition, not a supplier order or ordinary saved note. s5 represents only the shop's existing purchasing authority and must be confirmed; do not add a supervisor approval or let the author approve her own paperwork.
s1 counts actual equipment and requirement capture. s2 counts current price, revision and compatibility checks; no free new structured parts feed is assumed.

s2 removes5 of20 catalogue-navigation units and retains15 for actual selection and verification. s3 transfers only actual checked fields. Test native work-order/purchasing integration first; existing autofill and submission earn zero new gain.

s4 retains correction and final completion. The exact final requisition exists before s5; edits to part, quantity, price, job or destination void authority before s6. Upkeep includes failed transfer/submission repair.
s6 is the real queue submission, not a same-system save. s7 is negligible persistence and fully retained without an author gate. Shares are unmeasured estimates.
research_questions: Which requisition fields actually require manual transfer today?

already_counted.description: Actual equipment/requirement capture, retained catalogue checks and complete requisition verification remain counted.
Existing purchasing review remains outside focal labour.

incremental.description: Maintain catalogue/requisition mappings and repair failed transfer or submission cases.

approvals.approved_version: Exact final requisition completed in s4 and reviewed in s5; any part, quantity, price, job or destination change voids authority.

Low: catalogue revisions do not map cleanly, retaining18 of20 lookup units and15 of20 assembly units;2 plus5 plus4 submission units saved gives11/95*100 less3 upkeep, net8.5789, low8.5. Physical capture and complete compatibility checks remain full.

tasks.short: Interpret camera engineering references to plan repairs

steps.what: Retrieve the actual camera's engineering drawings, diagrams, instructions and specifications and verify their revision
inputs: actual camera model and serial range

steps.what: Read and interpret actual engineering drawings and specifications against the camera's observed condition
Determine the actual needed repairs and appropriate fabrication method from the interpreted references
Determine the actual operation sequence and check dependencies, tolerances and unresolved drawing ambiguities
outputs: determined operation sequence and unresolved questions

tasks.design: Link model, serial range and revision references in {OTHER}, the camera repair reference system, to the actual drawings in {DOCS}. The repairer still interprets the drawings and determines the repair, fabrication method and operation sequence.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the applicable drawing revision can require repeated navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native equipment/revision links remove retrieval without interpreting tolerances or selecting a repair.
tasks.still_hard: A drawing may not reflect the condition or prior modification of the actual camera.
tasks.human_edge: The repairer connects the diagram to the physical assembly and detects ambiguity.

ambition.what: No automated repair authorization or equipment operation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: model/revision links can shorten engineering-reference retrieval while interpretation remains skilled repair work.

assumptions: Boundary is actual reference interpretation and determining the work sequence, not performing repair or issuing a work instruction. No new sequence report is invented if the repairer does not keep or use one.
The repairer checks actual model/serial details and physical condition in s1-s3; no new free structured equipment capture is assumed.

The link removes3 of15 navigation units and retains12 for selecting and checking actual references. Reading35, repair judgment25 and operation-sequence judgment25 remain full. Existing native links earn zero new gain.
Any actual written work instruction, formal release or operative command needs its real writing and separate final-version authority/action. Shares are unmeasured estimates.
research_questions: Is actual reference retrieval repeated beyond native model/revision links?

already_counted.description: Actual reference checks, engineering interpretation and repair/fabrication/sequence judgment remain counted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R97 gives gross3 less upkeep0.5, net2.5. Low: an older serial range has ambiguous drawing revision metadata, retaining14.5 of15 lookup units;0.5 saved covers0.5 upkeep, net0. Technical reading and all repair judgments remain full.

tasks.short: Record test data and fabrication techniques

steps.what: Read the actual camera test outputs and capture test identifiers, values, units, settings and performed fabrication facts
Assemble the actual test-data report tables from the captured identifiers, values, units and settings
Document the actual fabrication techniques and their equipment-specific details in the report
Check the actual report against test outputs and performed fabrication and correct units, omissions and misleading descriptions
outputs: checked working test and fabrication report

steps.what: Save the ordinary report in the same repair-document workspace
inputs: checked working test and fabrication report
outputs: saved working test and fabrication report

tasks.design: Map actual captured test fields from {OTHER}, the camera test and repair system, and {SPREADSHEET} into report tables in {DOCS}. A fabrication-section layout supplies headings and repeated equipment fields while the repairer writes actual techniques and verifies the full report.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual test reports can repeat table assembly and equipment/header placement alongside substantive fabrication description.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit test-field mappings and native report layouts remove those defined assembly actions.
tasks.still_hard: Test settings and actual fabrication variations determine what the result means.
tasks.human_edge: The repairer knows what was physically done and recognizes a misleading report description.

ambition.what: No automated equipment acceptance or customer release.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: explicit test-field mappings can build report tables while actual fabrication descriptions and verification remain human.

assumptions: The task explicitly includes actual test/fabrication reports used in repair records; this is not a new report added to conversation. Boundary ends with the working report, not equipment certification or dispatch.

s1 counts real reading/capture of test identifier, value, unit, setting, equipment and performed fabrication. Actual testing and fabrication occur in their real tasks and are counted there once; no free new structured feed is assumed.
s2 prices only actual manual report-table assembly. Test native instrument exports and work-order reports first; existing automatic tables earn zero new gain.
s3 removes5 of25 repeated equipment/header placement units and retains20 for actual technique writing. s4 retains19 full report-check/correction units; upkeep includes failed mapping repair.
Save1 is negligible, fully retained and ungated. Any actual customer report send or formal acceptance needs its real authority after the final version and a separate action. Shares are unmeasured.
research_questions: Which table/header actions remain manual after the test system's existing report export?

already_counted.description: Actual test/fabrication capture, substantive technique writing and full report verification remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain test/report mappings and repair incompatible output cases.

tasks.short: Recommend photographic equipment changes and upgrades

steps.what: Read the actual equipment history and locate the relevant photographic, microfilming or film-developing specifications
Inspect actual equipment limitations and assess the user's photographic or film-processing needs
Compare actual design changes or upgrades for compatibility, usefulness and practical limitations
Explain the recommended design changes or upgrades and their limits directly to the actual user
outputs: equipment change or upgrade recommendation explained

tasks.design: Link actual equipment history and specifications in {OTHER}, the camera repair and equipment-reference system, and {DOCS}. Keep physical assessment, upgrade comparison and the actual recommendation conversation with the repairer.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant model/revision references can require separate navigation before an upgrade discussion.
tasks.enabler_now: Native history/specification links remove only that retrieval work.
tasks.still_hard: An upgrade can fit a catalogue description while failing the actual user's equipment or workflow.
tasks.human_edge: The repairer relates physical condition, compatibility and the user's practical needs.

ambition.what: No autonomous design change, purchase or equipment release.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: equipment-history/specification links can shorten preparation while upgrade judgment and explanation remain skilled repair work.

assumptions: Boundary is actual oral upgrade advice, not a written design-change order or purchase. No trailing recommendation report is invented where none is kept or read.
s1 reads real equipment records and s2 counts actual condition/user-needs capture; no new clean dataset is assumed.
The link removes2 of20 navigation units and retains18 for actual history/specification reading. Existing native links earn zero new gain; physical assessment, comparison and explanation remain full.
Any actual written proposal, design release or supplier order needs its real writing and authority, with a separate final-version send/commit. Shares are unmeasured estimates.
research_questions: Is navigation repeated beyond current repair-system reference links?

already_counted.description: Actual history reading, physical/user assessment, upgrade comparison and oral recommendation remain counted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R98 gives gross2 less upkeep1, net1. Low: modified legacy equipment lacks revision metadata, retaining19 of20 retrieval units;1 saved covers1 upkeep, net0. Physical assessment and recommendation judgment remain full.

reach: Work with actual purchasing staff on catalogue/requisition mappings and repair colleagues on test-output provenance.
